admin.role.title.description: Title of the page of one role.

admin.role.back.description: Link from the page of a role, or of a new one, back to the list of roles.

admin.role.facts.description: Heading of the region of a role's page with its key, position, permissions and badge.

admin.role.holders.defaultMessage: Los roles se conceden y se revocan en la página de administración de una cuenta.
admin.role.holders.description: Text on a role's page above the link to the account search, where the role is granted.

admin.role.edit.title.description: Heading of the form of a role's page that changes its position, permissions and badge.

admin.role.delete.title.description: Heading of the region of a role's page that deletes it.

admin.role.gone.description: Text on the page of a role that was deleted while the page was open.
